question: Where can I get renewable curtailment and redispatch volumes in Spain, by zone or node and by period?

answer.summary: REE (the TSO) publishes monthly renewable curtailment from day-ahead technical constraints by grid node (ERNI, GWh, PDF on ESIOS; Peninsula plus Baleares/Canarias in MWh). Redispatch volumes (technical-constraint energy up/down, PDBF phase I and real time) are open as national monthly/yearly series via the REData API, not by node. Per-unit data is restricted to market subjects; economic curtailment and daily series were not found public.
main_caveats: ERNI by node is a monthly Power BI PDF export (no CSV): the table lists only the Top 30 nodes (Oct 2026: 355 of 578 GWh); the chart shows more nodes but its values need image/chart reading.
ERNI counts only D-1 phase I technical constraints vs PDBF, renewable units with specific electrical location; the report itself says node values may not match the aggregate monthly value on ESIOS.
Colours in the PDF legend decide RTT vs RTD: text extraction loses the mapping (Oct 2026: RTT 569.4 GWh, RTD 8.7 GWh read from the rendered chart).
REData energia-restricciones has no unit field; values match REE report GWh x1000 (MWh). Down values are negative. Wider period/geo options (day, baleares, ccaa) returned HTTP 400.
Redispatch (restricciones tecnicas) is not renewable-only: it includes gas/other units scheduled for voltage control and stability; do not equate it with renewable curtailment.
answer.confidence_reason: Core sources opened and tested (PDF, API, report) with cross-check; ESIOS API, per-unit files and ENTSO-E could not be tested without credentials, and the full ERNI archive was only sampled by document id.

how_to_use.example_result: ACECA 220   Programa PDBF 77,28 GWh   ERNI 36,23 GWh   46,88 % nudo   0,30 % peninsular ; ALARCOS 220   20,68   9,63   46,55 %   0,08 %. Page 2 pie: RTT 569,4 GWh (98%), RTD 8,7 GWh (2%).
steps: Download the document by id (GET works; HEAD returns 403). 3386 is the latest-month alias; other months use separate ids, found by checking Content-Disposition (filename ERNI Nudos RR.TT PDBF Fase I_YYYYMM.pdf).
Page 3 holds the Top 30 table: parse with pdftotext -layout and a regex per row (node, kV, PDBF GWh, ERNI GWh, % node, % peninsular); decimal comma and thousands dot.
Page 2 has the bar chart with more nodes (about 56 in Oct 2026) and the RTT/RTD pie; read it as an image (pdftoppm -png -r 80) because colours carry the RTT/RTD legend.
Page 4 states the method and the RTT/RTD codes. TNP files give all island nodes in MWh with node, closing programme and %.
reading_traps: Top 30 table sums to 355.3 of the 578.1 GWh monthly total (Oct 2026): it is not the full list.
pdftotext output loses the colour legend: RTT is the large slice (blue) in Oct 2026; do not infer RTT/RTD from the text order.
Percent columns have two bases (node vs peninsular); node percent can reach 46.9 % while peninsular share is 0.30 %.
Filename and document id are not chronological (3386 is the rolling latest; 4245 is June 2026).
Report text: node ERNI may not match the monthly aggregate shown on the ESIOS website; unit is GWh for peninsular but MWh for TNP files.
